facts.fact: Government Paper No 3 of 2007, the National ICT Policy (Maitlamo), was approved by the National Assembly in August 2007, as stated by the Minister of Communications, Science and Technology.
facts.system: National Information and Communications Technology Policy (Maitlamo)

facts.fact: The full policy text is held, published by the Ministry of Communications, Science and Technology as Government Paper No 3 of 2007 (document published 2007-08, hosted on a UN public administration site).
facts.system: National Information and Communications Technology Policy (Maitlamo)

facts.fact: The contents list a Maitlamo governance structure of an Information Age Council, an ICT Legal Reform Taskforce, an enhanced Department of Information Technology and an e-Governance Structure; the section text was not captured, so the mandate is read from the headings.
